definicion.title: What are PMO consulting and project management services?
definicion.description: Project management services are the expert planning, direction, control, and execution of a business initiative so it meets the agreed time, cost, scope, and quality. At Cyrrus we specialize in technology and digital transformation projects (ERP, CRM, HCM, cloud, infrastructure, and AI) and manage them as an external PMO, accountable for the outcome and following PMBOK guidelines.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about project management

items.question: When should a company hire an external PMO?
items.answer: When the project is falling behind, going over budget, or no one owns the risk; when an in-flight project needs someone to diagnose the real cause and regain control; or when the company faces a one-off project, such as an ERP implementation, and doesn't want to hire and sustain an internal project office.

items.question: How does the external PMO model work?
items.answer: We act as an external PMO with real accountability for the outcome, not just status reports: project governance, quality assurance, and active risk management throughout execution.

items.question: What kind of projects do you manage?
items.answer: From complex implementations of mature and advanced technologies — ERP, CRM, HCM — to network infrastructure projects, cloud migration, and any kind of technology architecture, including artificial intelligence.

items.question: How do you measure project success?
items.answer: With results from a Cyrrus project: execution under PMBOK guidelines, zero scope deviations, and a 3% difference versus the estimated cost.

items.question: Is risk monitoring just a report at the end of each phase?
items.answer: No. We monitor project risk continuously with AI agents that flag deviations before they become crises, with full visibility into progress at every moment.

items.question: How long does a project with an external PMO take?
items.answer: It depends on scope and technology — there's no standard duration. As an external PMO we stay from kickoff through go-live and post-launch stabilization, with checkpoints and reporting to the steering committee throughout execution.

items.question: What's the difference between traditional project management and PMO as a Service (an outsourced PMO)?
items.answer: PMO as a Service is an external team that takes on project governance with real accountability for the outcome, without the company having to hire and sustain an internal project office. It's activated for a specific project — like an ERP implementation — and stood down at close.
